problem_statement: After a kernel change, work_cancel() and work_cancel_wq() (and their _sync variants) now return -ENOENT when the work item is not currently queued (and, for the sync variant, not running) rather than returning OK unconditionally. The wqueue ostest's api_validation_test still expects OK when cancelling idle work, and the zero-delay tester thread still asserts an exact OK return, so the test now fails against the new kernel behavior. Update the test to expect -ENOENT for idle work and to accept -ENOENT alongside OK for the raced zero-delay cancel.
